Transport form Prague to Pilsen 
 
How to get from Prague airport to Pilsen:  
Take a public bus number 100 (details) from the airport to Zličín. There you can: 
a. take a direct bus to Pilsen (flixbus.cz), duration 1 hour 
b. take the underground (metro), line B, to Florenc, then take a bus to Pilsen 
from there (also flixbus.cz or idos.cz), duration 1 hour 30 minutes 
c. take the underground (metro), line B, to Florenc, change to line C and go one 
stop to Hlavní Nádraží = Main Railway Station and take direct train to Pilsen 
(idos.cz), duration 1 hour 20 minutes  
You can check Pilsen's public transportation system here. The dormitories are close to tram 
line 4.  
• To get there, take tram number 1 or 2 from the railway station, go to "Hlavní Pošta" 
and then change to line 4. 
• From CAN (bus station), it's better to walk via Husova Street to Klatovská třída (tram 
stop called "U Práce") and then take tram number 4. 
Dorm Bolevecká: tram stop "Pod Záhorskem" 
Dorm Borská: tram stop "Dobrovského" 
Dorm Máchova 14,16, 20 and Klatovská: tram stop "Borský park"
